source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1949, p. 7
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)

note: Triennial election of the nine electoral divisions of Belfast rural district, one member each. There was no contest in the district in 1949; the News-Letter records the one change of member, Wilson Cupples succeeding D. Bryson at Ballysillan. The other eight divisions' members are filed from the Belfast and Ulster Directory 1950, p. 44a. New member, in place of Mr. D. Bryson. No contest in the district. Returned unopposed.
